Connect a native trusted client to a Tunnel Control Plane

Usage:
  ycy tunnel connect [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for connect
      --server string   Tunnel Control Plane origin
      --token string    Client Token

Global Flags:
      --log-format string   Diagnostic format: text or json
      --log-level string    Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
      --quiet               Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose             Enable debug diagnostics
